risks: CRM or quoting system failure during peak quote period
Website downtime during a major marketing campaign
Data loss — client project history, supplier contacts, financial records
mitigation: Cloud-based systems only — avoid local-server dependencies
Daily automated backups for all critical data
Documented disaster recovery process — who to call, what to restore first
Website uptime monitoring with immediate alert to management

risks: Sudden staff departure during peak project period
Rapid growth outstripping team capacity — quality suffers
Key person illness during complex project
mitigation: Document all client-facing processes so any trained person can manage
Maintain a pool of 2–3 trusted casual or contract installation crews
Cross-train sales and project management functions
Build hiring trigger: begin recruiting before capacity is exceeded, not after

risks: A failed project delivery receives a public negative review
mitigation: Respond to all negative reviews publicly within 24 hours — acknowledge, apologise, resolve
Proactively collect positive reviews after every successful project
Maintain TCD's Google Business Profile with accurate, up-to-date information
reputationRisk.responseProtocol: Acknowledge the experience. Apologise for the impact. Offer to resolve. Take conversation offline. Never argue publicly.

risks: Quote error — wrong pricing accepted by client creates loss-making project
Wrong product ordered — incorrect SKU placed with supplier
Delivery to wrong address or building
Invoice sent to wrong client or incorrect amount
mitigation: All quotes reviewed by a second person before sending for projects above $30,000
Supplier purchase orders cross-referenced against signed client quote before placement
Delivery address confirmed against lease/tenancy documentation before dispatch
Invoice reconciliation: every invoice matched to a signed quote before sending

overloadRisk.description: TCD takes on too many concurrent projects — quality suffers across all of them
overloadRisk.warningSign: Project manager handling more than 4 concurrent active projects simultaneously
mitigation: Define maximum concurrent project capacity and enforce it
Use project pipeline visibility to plan resource allocation 6–8 weeks ahead
Better to turn down a project than to damage the TCD reputation delivering it poorly

operationalExcellenceStandards.quoteResponseTime: Priority 1 leads: within 4 business hours. Standard enquiries: within 24 hours.
operationalExcellenceStandards.orderConfirmation: Supplier PO within 48 hours of client deposit received
operationalExcellenceStandards.deliveryNotification: Client notified of delivery booking minimum 3 business days prior
operationalExcellenceStandards.defectResponse: Acknowledged within 24 hours. Resolution plan provided within 72 hours.
